column1: # THE RANKING, AND THE ONE SUCCESSOR THIS ACT SELECTS.
#   A work package is RANKED BY HOW FAR IT MOVES THE
#   PROGRAMME, measured as the number of downstream packages it
#   UNBLOCKS, and it is QUALIFIED only if it has a named
#   R0 = it is on the critical path to the earliest
#        source set does not exist yet).
#   R1 = it is required for the M2 milestone.
#   R2 = it is required for the M2 milestone but is NOT on the
#        host-target critical path, so it can run in parallel.
#   R3 = it is a tool surface, not on the M2 path.
# The downstream_unblocked column is COMPUTED by reachability
# over the real dependency edges, not asserted.
# The successor is selected by the FIRST package that is
# RANKED R0, that has a named witness, and whose predecessors
# are all satisfiable. This is the ONLY successor this ACT
# opens; no other package is authorized by this document.
